name: Undenatured Type II Collagen + Glucosamine Sulfate + Chondroitin Sulfate
indication_description: The drug is indicated to treat osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, other joint pain & inflammation associated with injury and impaired joint function.
pharmacology_description: Glucosamine is a naturally occurring amino sugar of cartilage that provides the basic raw material needed by the body to manufacture joint cartilage. Chondroitin is another naturally occurring mucopolysaccharide of cartilage that stimulates cartilage production, inhibits cartilage destroying enzymes, draws fluid to the cells and helps lubricate the joints. Glucosamine and Chondroitin work synergistically together to help stimulate the production and regeneration of connective tissues (e.g., cartilage, bone, tendon, skin, mucous membrane, blood vessels etc.). Undenatured Type II Collagen also known as Chicken Collagen Type II that works by oral tolerization. This Undenatured type II Collagen contains epitopes that interacts with the peyer’s patch in the intestine. It prevents the immune system from releasing destructive collagen specific T-cell. This T-cell is responsible for degradation of collagen in the joints. This causes halting the erosion of joint cartilage. As inflammation subsides the disequilibrium of cartilage turnover shifts in favor of rebuilding. It appears that once the destructive cycle is broken, the joint cartilage begins to repair itself through collagen building activities that are part of normal cartilage remodelling process.
dosage_description: 1 tablet daily with meal or as directed by the physician.
interaction_description: There is no known drug interaction with Undenatured type II Collagen, Glucosamine and Chondroitin.
side_effects_description: Generally safe for most of the people but some may feel stomach problems.
pregnancy_and_lactation_description: There is not enough reliable information about the safety of taking the drug if you are pregnant or breast feeding. So it is better to avoid the drug during pregnancy and lactation.
overdose_effects_description: Abdominal discomfort may happen in case of overdose of drug.
storage_conditions_description: Do not store above 30⁰C. Protect from moisture and light and keep out of the reach of the children.
